thread:
jo: quick design q: keep asterisk or visible 'Required'? thinking about clarity for screen readers and translation.
felix: visible 'Required' label wins for a11y and i18n. asterisk is ambiguous.
anya: agree. make it low-contrast but still readable. a11y-bot: contrast check fails at #b3b3b3 for small text.
ops-bot: impl note: adding visible text is minor DOM cost.
jo: validation behavior: blur vs submit vs live?
felix: blur for most, live for confirmations (password match) but avoid live password policy errors.
anya: propose hybrid: inline errors on blur + top summary on submit with anchor links to fields. ensure focus is moved to first error without abrupt scroll and respect prefers-reduced-motion.
ops-bot: code hint: `el.focus({preventScroll: true}); el.scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth'});` check reduced motion.
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: inline errors should be present in DOM, use role="alert" for announcements, modal dialogs must trap focus and set aria-modal.
jo: destructive flows: delete project -> typed confirm for org/org-admin by default, undo toast only for less critical deletes. also add soft-delete + retention window.
felix: copy draft: "Delete project and all data. Type project name to confirm. This action is permanent." CTA: "Delete project" (danger).
anya: i'll produce compact + expanded specs with tokens, copy, and a11y notes. devs can pick variant in implementation.
jo: thanks all, will attach proto and file a ticket.
